title: Transactions, staged mutation and recovery
summary: The native transaction line preserves NOTEXECUTED versus ROLLEDBACK, staged/atomic mutation publication, recovery journals and ordered mutation evidence. Placement of transaction semantics at the shared database boundary must not erase NoSQLServer's richer native diagnostic/result surface.
invariants: A request rejected before operation begins is NOTEXECUTED.
A transaction that began and was atomically undone is ROLLEDBACK.
Those states must never be collapsed.
Interop is additive; native planner/recovery evidence remains available.
